cap.1995.1.1.printed_source_pages: 1995 CAP Prize Exam, Part A, page 1
cap.1995.1.1.source_format: Official CAP examination paper (English), as distributed by the organisers
cap.1995.1.1.source_variant_note: Problems © Canadian Association of Physicists / Canadian Physics Olympiad. 1995 CAP Prize Exam, English problem paper (file "1995e.pdf", a scan without text layer) (5 pages: instructions and data on page 1; Part A: Multiple Choice (Questions 1–25), pages 1–4; Part B: Questions 1–3, pages 4–5). The paper has two parts, stored as day 1/2 with paper_label "Part A"/"Part B" as printed (the instructions call them "sections A and B"); Part B items are printed "Question 1"–"Question 3" and are titled so. Options are lettered (a)–(d) as printed. The paper-wide data table (page 1) is not copied into the records; the constants needed for Part B Question 1 are added as a bracketed editorial line. The "Link to Solutions" box on page 5 is omitted. Printed bold "not" in Question 7 is kept as bold. The figures of Question 25 (Part A) and Part B Question 2 label the angle with a slashed-zero symbol (Ø), which the text calls θ (Question 25) and the angle to the normal (Part B Question 2). Official typos kept as printed: "is not true for electromagnetic waves;" (semicolon, Question 7), "an atmosphere which is ," (Question 19), the question marks missing after "bottom of the loop" (Question 16) and "describes the lens" (Question 17), "more dense that pure water" and "how far is it in the distance" (Part B Question 2).
